hyde county covers nearly 1,500 square miles of land and water in eastern north carolina, where long distances can slow conventional emergency response.
hyde county ems said flight-trained paramedic quinn reece used a pivotal blackfly evtol aircraft on two emergency response calls, carrying medical equipment and landing near the patients.

hyde county ems, pivotal and code blue resources developed procedures over a number of months and completed more than 300 training exercises before beginning operational flights; akute networks worked on the program as aviation program manager.
on one of the calls, reece arrived about 20 minutes before a ground ambulance and began providing advanced life support while other responders were still en route.

the blackfly is a lightweight, single-seat electric aircraft that can take off and land vertically; pivotal has positioned the blackfly and its newer helix aircraft as personal electric aircraft rather than commercial air taxis.
